dedupe_keys.name: lundisim open data multiresolution model meshes with porosity and permeability properties inspired from spe10 challenge for geoscience and data science applications

description: IFP Energies nouvelles and collaborators publish LUNDIsim, a synthetic reservoir benchmark inspired by the SPE10 challenge. It contains a common hexahedral corner-point grid and four meshes populated with porosity and permeability values representing distinct subsurface environments. Lower-resolution versions accompany the property models, supporting controlled comparisons of upscaling and numerical representation. Zenodo provides GRDECL mesh files, documentation and previews free under CC-BY-4.0. This is static synthetic coverage, not a measured field or a forecast reservoir state. A limitation is that exact grid dimensions and property units require the accompanying documentation before numerical use; they were not established from the repository summary. The meshes can test reservoir-flow simulators, storage calculations and data-compression methods under consistent geometries. They complement SPE10 by offering multiple geological settings and resolutions. The review did not download a mesh, inspect the PDF documentation or execute a solver.
